{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|eff= global

|gr1= Interaction

|descr= Make a unit perform an action immediately (without any animation/pre-processing). See the [[action]] command for more information.

|s1= unit [[actionNow]] actionArray

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= actionArray: [[Array]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player actionNow ["TakeBag", _backpack]; // pick up a backpack without any animation</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>player actionNow ["Gear", vehicle player]; // open inventory while in vehicle</sqf>
